issues.description: A guest who finds no free table joins the waitlist, and the restaurant texts the first guest on it when a table frees. Q4, after no-show fees.

comments.author: Rebecca Holm
comments.body: BOK-262 is out behind the waitlist flag. BOK-265 next.

issues.summary: Join the waitlist from the booking page
issues.description: When the booking page has no free table for the time a guest asked for, it offers the waitlist instead: name, party size, phone number, and the window the guest can come in.

comments.author: Amir Haddad
comments.body: Shipped behind the waitlist flag. No restaurant has it on yet. Closing.

issues.summary: Text the first guest on the waitlist when a table frees
issues.description: A cancellation frees a table, so the first guest on the waitlist for that window gets a text with a link to take it. The offer runs out after fifteen minutes and moves on.

comments.author: Rebecca Holm
comments.body: The cancel path sends the text. The 15-minute window and the hand-off to the next guest are what is left.

issues.description: A restaurant with fees switched on takes a card when the guest books, and charges a fee when the guest does not turn up. The first release has one fee per restaurant, on bookings from the restaurant website and from Google. Card storage goes through PAY-190.

comments.author: Rebecca Holm
comments.body: Spike done (BOK-301). PAY-190 stores the card and gives us a token to charge later. No stories yet. I want them before sprint planning on 22 July.

issues.summary: Spike: store a card through PAY-190
issues.description: Find out whether PAY-190 can hold a card at booking and give us a token to charge days later, and what the Payments team needs from us to do it.

comments.author: Rebecca Holm
comments.body: Works against the PAY-190 test account. The token comes back on the booking record. Closing.

issues.summary: Reminder SMS sent twice for Google bookings
issues.description: Guests who book through the Google button get the day-before reminder twice, once from the Google booking record and once from ours. Sjögatan reported it on 2026-06-24 and Pizzeria Napoli on 2026-06-26, both through support. Four tickets so far.

comments.author: Jonas Berg
comments.body: Four support tickets so far, all Google bookings. The macro says we are looking into it.

comments.author: Amir Haddad
comments.body: Fixed: one reminder per booking whatever the source. Released in the 09:10 deploy on 2026-07-17.

issues.description: Parties over eight book a set menu and pay a deposit. It waits on PAY-210 (deposits), so Roadmap H2 says Q1 2027.

issues.summary: Table areas on the booking page
issues.description: A restaurant names the areas it seats guests in, and a guest picks one when booking. An area with no free table for that time is shown as full.

comments.author: Amir Haddad
comments.body: Released. A restaurant names its areas (window, terrace, bar) and guests pick one when they book.

issues.description: The booking page in Finnish, for the restaurants that asked for it. Same text as the Swedish page, translated once and kept in the same file.
A guest books from the restaurant's Google listing instead of finding the website first. The booking lands in the same list as every other one.

comments.author: Amir Haddad
comments.body: Live for every restaurant. Switch it on under Settings, Booking channels.

issues.summary: Store a card for a later charge
issues.description: Take a card at booking, keep it with the acquirer, and hand back a token the booking side can charge days later. Nothing is charged here.

comments.author: Henrik Dahl
comments.body: Done. The token lives with the payment provider; we keep only the reference. BOK-300 can start.

issues.summary: Deposits: charge at booking, refund on cancellation
issues.description: A guest pays a deposit when the booking is made, and gets it back when the booking is cancelled in time. Planned for Q4.

comments.author: Henrik Dahl
comments.body: Design started. No date yet: the refund path depends on the acquirer.

pages.title: Roadmap H2
pages.body:
Roadmap H2 2026

Committed

No-show fees: Q4. A card at booking, charged when the guest does not turn up. (BOK-300)

Waitlist: Q4, after no-show fees. (BOK-260)

Next

Group bookings: Q1 2027, after the Payments team ships deposits (PAY-210). (BOK-520)

Not doing

Gift cards. Declined on 2026-03-10, for the second time.

pages.title: Changelog
pages.body:
Changelog

What changed in Bord, newest first. This page is public.

2026-06-24

Bookings taken by phone now show in the same list as online bookings. One list for the evening, whatever the source.

2026-05-12

Book a table from Google. Guests can book from your restaurant's Google listing with a "Book a table" button. Switch it on under Settings, Booking channels.

2026-04-02

One reminder, the day before. Guests get one text reminder for a booking, the day before at 17:00.
